Independent literal scans cover all 9^4 parameter cases and all palindromes length<=26; not an unbounded certificate.

value.rationale: Palindromic words have odd run count; seven is the first run count capable of carrying a long six-run minimal antisquare in this symmetric setting. The exact center-vs-boundary inequality distinguishes a genuinely nonlocal obstruction while the rational enumerator classifies every length, a motivated infinite structural result rather than an arbitrary slice. Its dependence on the general antisquare theorem is credited.
